description: 1 double bedroom, 2 single bedrooms, 1 bathroom with bathtub, 1 shower bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Single-aspect apartment — windows on left facade(s). Kitchen is adjacent to a window — well-lit cooking position. 1 double bedroom (no walk-in wardrobe, no en-suite), 2 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: single-wall, no island. Cook faces the wall, back to the living and dining area. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 4 seats. Bathroom config: 1 bathroom(s) with bathtub; 1 shower-only bathroom(s). Parallel morning routines possible — separate shower and WC available. Largest bedroom close to entry and kitchen — convenient morning access, less acoustic separation from activity. 2 of 2 single bedroom(s) have a desk visible in plan. Each single bedroom is large enough to accommodate a bunk bed for two children. Possible configurations — mutually exclusive: (1) all as children's bedrooms; (2) one children's bedroom and one home office or hobby room; (3) all as home offices or hobby rooms; (4) one or both as guest rooms; (5) bunk bed arrangement extending household capacity. Cannot simultaneously provide two separate children's bedrooms and a dedicated home office without a bunk bed in one bedroom. Storage room in entry or private zone, not adjacent to kitchen — suitable for coats, shoes, bikes, laundry or utility storage, not as kitchen pantry. From entry: kitchen is immediate, living area is short corridor. No door between entry and living/kitchen — relevant where local regulations require separation. Suits: families with one or two children, people working from home in a dedicated room.
not_suitable_for: household requiring two children's bedrooms and a dedicated home office simultaneously without bunk bed arrangement
jurisdictions requiring door separation between entry and kitchen
